name: Orca
tagline: Glance at oh-my-pi sessions and reply by voice
description: Shows the oh-my-pi coding-agent sessions running in Orca, what each last said, and which need you. Tap a session to read it and reply by voice; replies are only typed when the agent is at its prompt.
author: Orca

permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Connects to the Orca desktop you paired with to read sessions and send replies.

permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: Records your spoken reply while you hold or tap; Orca transcribes it on your computer.
